# `memory` check

Check RAM usage on this machine.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: memory
    expect:
      used: { warn: 85%, fail: 95% }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.used` | {warn, fail} percent | `{warn: 85%, fail: 95%}` | Share of RAM in use. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |
| `expect.available` | {warn, fail} size |  | RAM available for new work. Triggers when the value is below the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check memory [--set key=value ...]`
